card.name: Linking words in drug interaction text
card.fires_on: Small linking words (with, their, the, a, exhibit) right after a drug or enzyme noun in drug-interaction passages, just before a descriptive phrase such as CYP3A induction effects, active metabolite or narrow therapeutic index.

modes.label: "with" after drug class
modes.description: The word with follows a drug class or substrate and introduces a property of it.
modes.example: Anticonvulsants<< with>> CYP3A induction effects that are

modes.label: their/the/a before metabolite or action
modes.description: A pronoun or article comes just before active metabolite or a drug's described action.
modes.example: efficacy is mainly due to<< their>> active metabolite(s), concomitant

card.plain: It marks small joining words in drug-interaction sentences, just before a drug's property is described.
